objects: physical cards currently on top of the instructed player's library
state_writes: one complete bottom-bottom-first, untouched-middle, top-bottom-first library order
timing: during resolution of one represented Scry instruction
choices: a complete private top and bottom partition
independent exact order for each partition
hidden_information: looked-at identities and the resulting library order remain private to the instructed player
apnap: ordinary single-player Scry uses no APNAP choice
copy: copied represented spells reuse the source-pinned fixed Scry node
control_change: the resolving instruction identifies the current controller before the private choice is issued
zone_change: the exact looked-at physical cards must remain the current library top through completion
source_leaves: resolution depends on the pinned instruction rather than continued source presence

variants: positive fixed-count Scry for the controller
Scry larger than the current library

implementation.component: ScryChoiceHandler, LibraryPartitionChoice, ScryArrangement, ScryLibraryIntent, and commit_scry_arrangement
implementation.supported_slice: One resolved controller Scry count through the private partition: zero creates no event; positive empty-library instructions complete their action and can trigger represented normalized player observers. Public counts require the separate typed quantity capability.

known_blockers: multiple players instructed to Scry simultaneously require an APNAP decision coordinator and simultaneous commit
unrepresented dynamic and variable Scry counts remain residual
effects that add cards while Scrying remain residual
Scry-event consumer grammar beyond represented normalized fixed-body observers remains residual
Surveil, fateseal, and non-Scry library ordering are separate capabilities
